title: Perfect Sandwiches
statementMd:
Monocarp has 𝑎a slices of cheese and 𝑏b slices of sausage. He wants to make the maximum possible number of sandwiches for his friends from them.

Monocarp is very thrifty, so he must use all 𝑎a slices of cheese and all 𝑏b slices of sausage without any leftovers to make the sandwiches. In addition, he has the following rules for making sandwiches:

- each sandwich must contain at least one slice of cheese and at least one slice of sausage;
- each of the 𝑎a slices of cheese and each of the 𝑏b slices of sausage must be placed on exactly one sandwich;
- for each sandwich, the number of slices of cheese must be **strictly greater** than the number of slices of sausage.

Help Monocarp determine the maximum number of sandwiches he can make, or determine that it is impossible to distribute all slices according to these rules.

## Input

The first line contains an integer 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤1041≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The only line of each test case contains two integers 𝑎a and 𝑏b (1≤𝑎,𝑏≤1001≤a,b≤100) — the number of slices of cheese and sausage, respectively.

## Output

For each test case, print one integer — the maximum number of sandwiches that can be made. If it is impossible to distribute all pieces according to the described rules, print −1−1 instead.

## Note

In the first test case, it is possible to make 22 sandwiches. For example, each of the two sandwiches can be made from three slices of cheese and two pieces of sausage.

In the second test case, it is possible to make 11 sandwich from five slices of cheese and one slice of sausage.

In the third test case, it is impossible to make sandwiches while using all slices of cheese and sausage, so you have to print −1−1.
statementZhMd:
Monocarp 有 $a$ 片奶酪和 $b$ 片香肠，他想用这些材料为朋友们制作尽可能多的三明治。

Monocarp 非常节俭，因此他必须把所有 $a$ 片奶酪和所有 $b$ 片香肠毫无剩余地全部用来制作三明治。此外，他制作三明治时还遵循以下规则：

- 每个三明治必须至少包含一片奶酪和至少一片香肠；
- $a$ 片奶酪中的每一片和 $b$ 片香肠中的每一片都必须恰好放在某一个三明治上；
- 对于每个三明治，奶酪的片数必须**严格大于**香肠的片数。

请帮助 Monocarp 求出他能制作的三明治数量的最大值，或者判断按照这些规则无法分配所有切片。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）——表示测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的唯一一行包含两个整数 $a$ 和 $b$（$1 \le a, b \le 100$）——分别表示奶酪片数和香肠片数。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——表示能制作的三明治的最大数量。如果无法按照所述规则分配所有切片，则输出 $-1$。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，可以制作 $2$ 个三明治。例如，这两个三明治中的每一个都可以由三片奶酪和两片香肠制成。

在第二个测试用例中，可以用五片奶酪和一片香肠制作 $1$ 个三明治。

在第三个测试用例中，无法在使用完所有奶酪和香肠的前提下制作三明治，因此必须输出 $-1$。
